# blackscholes

> Closed-form Black-Scholes-Merton, Black-76, binary options, and option structures. No runtime dependencies.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) — agent conventions
- [.github/README.MD](.github/README.MD) — usage
- [docs/](docs/) — mkdocs (price, greeks, structures)

## Code

- [src/blackscholes/base.py](src/blackscholes/base.py) — d1/d2, PDF/CDF, shared greeks
- [src/blackscholes/call.py](src/blackscholes/call.py) — BSM / Black-76 / binary call
- [src/blackscholes/put.py](src/blackscholes/put.py) — BSM / Black-76 / binary put
- [src/blackscholes/straddle.py](src/blackscholes/straddle.py)
- [src/blackscholes/strangle.py](src/blackscholes/strangle.py)
- [src/blackscholes/butterfly.py](src/blackscholes/butterfly.py)
- [src/blackscholes/iron_butterfly.py](src/blackscholes/iron_butterfly.py)
- [src/blackscholes/iron_condor.py](src/blackscholes/iron_condor.py)
- [src/blackscholes/spread.py](src/blackscholes/spread.py)
- [src/blackscholes/__init__.py](src/blackscholes/__init__.py) — public API
- [tests/](tests/) — golden values + parity
